credit_ledger_kind_sign.name: credit_ledger_kind_sign
credit_ledger_kind_sign.value: ("credit_ledger"."kind" in ('grant', 'topup') and "credit_ledger"."amount" > 0) or ("credit_ledger"."kind" in ('expire', 'spend', 'refund') and "credit_ledger"."amount" < 0) or "credit_ledger"."kind" in ('adjustment', 'reversal')

lse_loss_reason_ck.name: lse_loss_reason_ck
lse_loss_reason_ck.value: "lead_stage_event"."to_stage_kind" <> 'lost' OR "lead_stage_event"."approximate" = true OR "lead_stage_event"."loss_reason" IS NOT NULL

media_library_item_variant_ready_ck.name: media_library_item_variant_ready_ck
media_library_item_variant_ready_ck.value: "media_library_item"."variant_status" <> 'ready' or ("media_library_item"."variant_storage_key" is not null and "media_library_item"."variant_size_bytes" is not null and "media_library_item"."variant_mime_type" is not null)

menu_config_name.name: menu_config_name
menu_config_name.value: ("menu_config"."kind" = 'active' and "menu_config"."name" is null) or ("menu_config"."kind" = 'template' and char_length("menu_config"."name") between 1 and 60)
